findings.title: Both fixed child hygiene loops close the already-closed proc enumeration descriptor and abort the normal connected path
causal_path: kernel120_named_root_entry -> execute_original32_serial -> kernel120_named_root_case -> kernel120_launch_stock_before_opaque -> atomic stock child -> kernel120_child_bootstrap.

The child's list(Path('/proc/self/fd').iterdir()) is produced by current Python3.14 pathlib:830-842: open os.scandir, consume entries, close scandir, then return the entry iterator. Linux /proc/self/fd lists that scandir descriptor while it is open.

For the ordinary valid case with 0,1,2 open, that descriptor is >2 and is not an already-open keep descriptor. At owner:1072 os.close of this cached now-closed numeric entry raises EBADF. The stock child's catch at1117 exits125 before GNU exec, actor-ready and the intended gate. Root cannot complete the first normal cohort and retains STOP custody.

The post-terminal helper repeats the same cached enumeration at1223-1225 without recognizing the transient entry; at1227 it exits125 before kernel120_post_terminal_helper. Its parent may already have closed current output originals before helper GO, so the later exact helper status0 predicate fails rather than providing normal cleanup.
The changed custody observation helper591-602 and existing host1532-1537 explicitly distinguish this same transient enumeration case; neither correction is used by the two child loops.

counterexample.input: Valid first ALL_SAFE phase with normal open standard descriptors and a valid live keep set; no malformed resource, injected kernel errno, role mismatch, timeout or race is required.
counterexample.deduction: The proc directory enumeration's own FD is cached while open, closed by the context manager, and then treated as a live owned descriptor by the child loop. Child exits125 before its intended normal continuation.
counterexample.current_dependency: Source PYTHON symlink and /usr/bin/python3 resolve to /usr/bin/python3.14; exact pathlib Source and interpreter ELF are recorded in CURRENT-PYTHON-ITERDIR-DEPENDENCY.json and EXACT-CURRENT-DEPENDENCIES.json.
counterexample.runtime: NOT_RUN; no candidate function, child, scandir control or target interpreter invoked.

findings.expected_behavior: Take a finite snapshot that distinguishes the exact transient enumeration entry from actual inherited descriptors, close only verified owned unwanted descriptors once, retain every declared keep handle, and stop on genuine unexpected/ambiguous close failure. Do not blanket-suppress EBADF for arbitrary owned handles.
required_controls: Real isolated fixed stock bootstrap reaches actual GNU exec/actor-ready/arm/GO with correct keep identities under the original caps and clock.
Real isolated final helper reaches normal current cleanup and exact direct wait0; verify complete current/future/batch custody and original outside caller slot.
Meaningful missing/reused/ambiguous actual inherited FD controls remain STOP without guessed retries; only the independently identified enumeration transient is excluded.
Full original32, current C45/FD8, H991, C59_28 and C55_41 remain separately mandatory after exact new Source Safety and a fresh actual Root action admission.

findings.title: Whole auxiliary preflight ignores ownership role/identity declarations that are rejected only after caller and Root prefix effects
causal_path: The global auxiliary planner reads local physical identity and ownership.caller_fd for groups, and records no caller owner at all for outputs. It never checks ownership.role or ownership.identity against the semantic group/output-parent role.

kernel120_existing_caller_prepare calls that planner before collecting every row, but rebuilds auxiliary group roles as the constant auxiliary_group at243-246 and auxiliary output parents at248-249. It does not validate these original ownership declarations. ExistingCallerCustody consequently has a valid actual group/parent table and performs its FIRST role bindings at141; retain_in_existing_caller then mutates the persistent holder.
The fixed Root entry repeats the same incomplete semantic planner and can perform control/trace bindings at1587-1589 plus original clock/catalog record effects at1598-1602.

Only produce_original32_phase_inputs invokes the negative auxiliary physical preflight at185. kernel120_auxiliary_actual_owner finally checks exact requested ownership.role and ownership.identity at1671-1673 and raises for the known bad suffix row.
The eventual failure is fail-closed and retains the external original slot; it is nevertheless too late for the stipulated ZERO TOTAL caller/Root bind/derived-record/close prefix.

counterexample.input: All23 otherwise valid distinct phase capabilities. The last negative phase has one otherwise valid independent owned auxiliary group, with correct local identity, correct actual caller FD and valid retained parent; its ownership.role is auxiliary_borrowed instead of auxiliary_group. An equivalent auxiliary output row may use the wrong ownership role/identity while its genuine private parent is valid.
counterexample.preflight: Global local inode/path/mount/FD checks pass. Caller preparation builds the correct constant actual group/parent role from the physical capability, ignores the contradictory ownership metadata, and binds its actual roles.
counterexample.refusal: Owner:1671-1673 later refuses with 'exact auxiliary requested ownership role', after caller/Root binding and original record prefix effects. No candidate function was invoked.
counterexample.scope_limit: This does not say the newly added duplicate-owned-inode checks are missing: those exact duplicate cases are now rejected globally. The missing part is semantic ownership adjudication before first binding.

findings.expected_behavior: Validate every group's/output's declared owner role, identity, caller handle association and compatible semantic lifetime against the complete actual caller inventory before the FIRST caller/Root role binding or derived record. Preserve late fresh physical revalidation and all slot-retention stops.
required_controls: Put wrong group ownership.role and wrong output-parent ownership.role/identity at the LAST row after at least three valid rows; assert exact intended refusal and ZERO TOTAL caller_role_bind, Root_role_bind, derived_validated_record, resource-close, rmdir, umount and first_birth counters from the original preparation boundary.
A contradictory or wrong-inode remote caller declaration must likewise refuse before first binding; genuine owned group/output and explicit legitimate borrowed sharing must retain positive controls.
Keep every original caller slot/capability physically unchanged on the preflight refusal; no metadata-only zero or resetting counters at the local phase boundary.

findings.title: The whole plan accepts auxiliary phase lifetimes for normal/uncertainty phases that have no cleanup consumer
causal_path: preflight_auxiliary_phase_plans collects auxiliary groups/outputs/borrowed handles from EVERY phase, without limiting them to NEGATIVE_CONTRACTS. produce_whole_role_plan assigns each accepted auxiliary handle a current phase lifetime and the purpose current_auxiliary_once_only_cleanup.

The producer stores actual_control_bindings and calls auxiliary physical preflight only for negative phases at181-186. The serial executor invokes kernel120_cleanup_auxiliary_control only through kernel120_control_inputs.dispatch_negative.

ALL_SAFE and all four uncertainty phases call kernel120_named_root_case, whose post-terminal helper cleans only the main current group/output. It neither consumes nor closes the accepted current auxiliary inventory.

After the current helper/group closes, verify_current_effect_closure sees the still-live planned auxiliary current row; because it is not trace_directory, owner:888-889 -> custody:553-554 raises ROOT_CURRENT_EFFECT_STILL_LIVE. complete_phase and the next phase cannot proceed.

Thus an auxiliary handle is accepted into the complete physical role plan with an explicit current cleanup lifetime but has no consumer on those accepted phase paths. This failure is independent of the child enumeration blocker; it would remain after that blocker is fixed.

counterexample.input: ALL_SAFE contains one valid distinct empty action-private auxiliary group, correctly owned in the actual existing caller, with valid original parent and no reserved/cross-role/cross-phase alias. Include its parent among the required retained auxiliary parent capabilities. Other22 phases and all main capabilities are valid.
counterexample.deduction: Global semantic and whole role planning accept that group FD as ALL_SAFE/auxiliary_group. Assuming the earlier child bootstrap defect is corrected and the normal main cohort cleans successfully, no branch closes/removes this auxiliary node, so current closure necessarily fails after main cleanup.
counterexample.runtime: NOT_RUN; no real fixture/admission or physical fit claimed.

findings.expected_behavior: Every accepted phase-owned auxiliary handle must have an explicit once-only cleanup consumer on its phase path. If such auxiliary inventories are unsupported for a phase, reject them globally before first binding/record/birth and declare that exact contract; do not whitelist live current auxiliaries or mark them closed.
required_controls: A supported nonempty auxiliary inventory in ALL_SAFE and an uncertainty phase must either complete genuine once-only cleanup under unchanged constraints or produce a specific pre-prefix refusal at the complete plan boundary.
Verify no main group/output is removed and no current/batch/future FD is closed before a known unsupported auxiliary phase plan is refused.
Preserve standard empty-auxiliary ALL_SAFE/four-cuts and independent valid distinct negative auxiliary inventory; no mandatory original scenario or budget reduction.
